editorial_alignment_v2.critical_note: The edited word has ŕ, while Fletcher's upper-case transcription writes R. Do not use unaccented string matching to assert graphic sign identity.
segmentation_hypotheses: (previous word + BAS)|BITEROKE|TINE (Fletcher's stated alternative at VII-B-7)
editorial_alignment_v2.segmentation_note: The additional -TE- is attested editorially in V-19, not VII-B-7; earlier hypothetical VII-B 'bas|biteŕoke|te|tine' was an invalid conflation of testimonies and is retired. Fletcher explicitly cautions BAS may be the end of the preceding word despite dotted separation.
